decision_rule: Read run a (deck as written); if E6 is REFUSED, read run b with the label 'viscosity-only protocol; the deck's heat flux does not run on the GPU pair style'. NOT_READ if that run did not finish, its output is degenerate, or it failed the sanity control (E8). HOLDS if 100 <= ns/day <= 625; REFUTED_BELOW below 100; REFUTED_ABOVE above 625.
metric: card PROXY throughput_ns_day = 250: ns/day of the deck as written on one A100, Performance line
